titleStmt.title: The Secretary General of the League of Nations (Avenol) to the Secretary of State

div.head: The Secretary General of the League of Nations (Avenol) to the Secretary of State
div.p: The Council, by a decision taken on the same day, September 30th, instructed me to transmit the said resolution to your Government.
I have the honour further to transmit to you, for information, a copy of the report referred to in the first paragraph of the above resolution.

note.p: Transmitted to the Department by the Minister in Switzerland in his despatch No. 606, L. N. 309, October 19, 1938; received November 3.
League of Nations document A.76.1938.VII., Geneva, September 29, 1938, not reprinted.
